import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Survival Rate by Sex
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_ylim([0, 1])
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# 2. Survival Rate by Class
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].mean()
survival_by_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#EAFFD0'])
ax2.set_title('Survival Rate by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax2.set_ylim([0, 1])
ax2.set_xticklabels(ax2.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)

# 3. Age Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax3.hist(df['age'].dropna(), bins=10, color='#A8E6CF', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    subset = df[df['pclass'] == pclass]['fare']
    ax4.scatter([pclass] * len(subset), subset, alpha=0.6, s=100, label=f'Class {pclass}')
ax4.set_title('Fare by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')
ax4.legend()

# 5. Survival Count
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors_survival = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
ax5.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_survival, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('Survival Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Embarkation Town
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
embark_counts = df['embark_town'].value_counts()
embark_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color='#FFD93D')
ax6.set_title('Passengers by Embarkation Town', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)

# 7. Survival by Sex and Class
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
survival_pivot = df.pivot_table(values='survived', index='sex', columns='class', aggfunc='mean')
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax7, width=0.8)
ax7.set_title('Survival Rate by Sex and Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax7.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax7.legend(title='Class')
ax7.set_xticklabels(ax7.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax7.set_ylim([0, 1])

plt.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Visualization', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
